asset.name: Gallery
asset.description: The responsive media collection with stable aspect ratios, progressive loading, selection, pagination, captions, keyboard navigation, and lightbox integration.

requires.reason: Layout is reserved before media resolves so nothing shifts on load.
Loading, error, and layout reservation are shared.
Collection semantics and keyboard navigation are shared.
Loading, empty, partial, stale, error, and offline presentation are delegated rather than reimplemented.

suggests.reason: Full-size inspection needs an immersive overlay; a thumbnail strip may not.

rationale: One of the few surfaces where controlled irregularity belongs: forcing every image into an identical tile discards composition information the content itself carries.
